question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The _____ term "wasteland" is proposed to be replaced by the term "urban commons."
solution:
The correct answer is "**derogatory.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given sentence, the blank will explain how the term "wasteland" is inappropriate and it should be replaced.**
 
• **Among the given options, the correct word to use in the blank is "derogatory."**
 
 
• **The word "derogatory" means showing a disrespectful or critical attitude.**(अपमानजनक)
 
 
• Example: Don't use such derogatory words for your colleagues!
 
 
 
 
 
• In this context, the term "wasteland" is being replaced because it is seen as derogatory towards urban areas.
 
• The use of the word "urban commons" instead of "wasteland" is meant to emphasize the potential for shared public spaces in cities.
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• The derogatory__ term "wasteland" is proposed to be replaced by the term "urban commons."
 
 

Hence,** the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "lucrative," means producing a lot of profit.(लाभप्रद)
 
• Option 3, "imperative," means crucial or necessary. (अनिवार्य)
 
• Option 4, "indicative," means serving as a sign or indication.(सूचक)
